fields.summary_ko.0: SK Haiix target price estimates show significant divergence, with SK Securities and Kyobo Securities at KRW 4 million (170% upside vs. current KRW 1.472 million) and BNK Investment Securities at KRW 1.65 million (large discount vs. average KRW 3 million range).
fields.summary_ko.1: Bullish view emphasizes sustained earnings improvement through expanded HBM4 supply and DRAM price increases with high demand visibility through 2029, raising 2027 operating profit forecast to KRW 488 trillion (70% increase year-over-year).
fields.summary_ko.2: Bearish view notes memory demand momentum is slowing and AI company credit risk plus sustained high rates create uncertainty in future investment cycle sustainability, with foreign investors shifting to selling despite share buybacks.
